name: Time Doctor
summary: Time Doctor costs $6.67 to $16.70 per user a month on annual billing, with no free plan and a 14-day trial of Premium. Screenshots and activity levels are core features on every plan, and approval of manual time entries starts on Standard.

evidence.capability: time entry or clock in and out

facts.text: Approval in Time Doctor covers manual time entries rather than whole timesheets, and disapproved entries drop out of reports.
Time Doctor records keyboard and mouse activity levels and states that the actual keys pressed are not recorded.
Screenshots are switched on per user, with an option to blur them.
The payroll feature on Standard and Premium exports CSV files for PayPal, Wise, Gusto, Payoneer and ADP.
Tracking history is kept for 3 months on Basic, 6 months on Standard and 2 years on Premium.
The terms renew subscriptions automatically and ask for written notice of non-renewal at least 30 days before the term ends.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Billed annually; $14 on monthly billing. Adds manual time approval, payroll and app and website reports

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Billed annually; $20 on monthly billing. Adds single sign-on, video screen recording and API access

hiddenCosts: Single sign-on on Basic or Standard is an add-on at $200 per account a month.
Native HRIS and payroll integrations are add-ons at $200 per integration a month.
Several reporting features are add-ons at $2 or $3 per user a month on Basic and Standard.
Prices exclude VAT and sales tax.

contract.cancellation: Fees are non-refundable, and the terms ask for written notice of non-renewal at least 30 days before the term ends.
contract.dataExport: Custom exports as CSV, XLS or PDF on every plan; API access on Premium and Enterprise.
